title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode1 A Merry Christmas

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My dear friends!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are currently ranked third in the Phoenix Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For a group with so few members performing on such a small stage, this is not a bad result. However! We must aim higher!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to put on a show so incredible, it will blow the audience away and send us to the top. Then we'll be featured in a TV commercial... And from there, earn world fame!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Moving on...
Can we actually discuss our next show now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guh... Not listening to me as usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? You look lost in thought, Emu.
What's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, er... I was just wondering what our next show should be like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's it going to be? I'd like a razzle-dazzle show that makes everyone go WOW!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's my thinking exactly.
A gripping and glamorous show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, we don't have the time to be toying with vague concepts like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're right behind the group in second, but there's a huge gap between us and the top group from the Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really? Yikes...! You're right!
It's almost double what we got!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our last show earned us some notoriety, but that's still a huge gap to close if we're going to aim for the top.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely. Which is why jabbering about razzle-dazzle or the wow factor won't do us much good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to seriously raise the bar and come up with something so exceptional that the audience will go wild!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's come up with some concrete ideas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not easy to come up with something on the spot, you know...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if you're all drawing a blank, we might be able to move things along...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Don't tell me you've already got something, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nice, you never fail to rise to the circumstances!
That's my esteemed director! So, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tis the season so...
A Christmas show seems like a no-brainer.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line: A Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's it! I love it! We can have lots of singing and dancing in it too, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aaand! One of us could dress up as Santa and give presents to the audience! How about that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Presents? Of course...! We can attach little notes that even say, Please vote for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's bribery.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-right...! I'm ashamed of letting such a thought creep into my mind...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... You don't need to make a big deal about it every time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A Christmas-themed show should draw in a large audience at this time of year, but what sort of performance were you thinking of exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tis season to be jolly, and what better way to express that than by singing? Hence, a musical.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A musical?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And how does everyone feel about A Merry Christmas for the title?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds okay, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and the plot goes something like this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have a lonely girl living in an orphanage somewhere, but has never been visited by Santa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She isn't expecting to see him this Christmas either, but...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A young boy, Santa's apprentice, appears at her window.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alas, he's lost his reindeers, and with them, all the presents he was entrusted with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The girl decides to help him out, and so begins their Christmas adventure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's what I have so far.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! It has a razzle-dazzle factor and makes you go WOW♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But wait a minute... The main protagonist of this story is that orphan girl, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ARE YOU GOING TO HAVE ME BE A LITTLE GIRL?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did you even arrive at that conclusion...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have two protagonists, the girl and Santa's apprentice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking of having Tsukasa play as the apprentice and Nene as the girl.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What, me...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why not Emu? She's probably much better for this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show will reach its climax during the scene where the girl sings.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've been starring in musicals since you were little, so I thought you'd be the perfect fit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But me as the heroine...
I'm not sure if I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is great, Nene! We'll get to hear your amazing singing♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, I haven't agreed to anything yet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You don't want to?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I really want to hear you sing♪
I love your singing voice sooo much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Besides, we might both be leads, but I am the one that's going to steal the spotlight in the end!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By jumping around and being obnoxious?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Hey, that's rude! Don't get so cocky just because you have a singing role!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. How about it, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do great, and the others seem to share my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If it's a musical, it should be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. I'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Rui, what do I get to be?
Can I be a reindeer?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For you I have the role of a child eagerly awaiting her Christmas presents. I'll be playing a minor role as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Once I'm done testing Robo-Nene, it should be ready to perform in the show as well. We're all going to be in it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! Let's get to work on this!
We're going to make it to the top this time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do this! Wonderhoy!
